proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 708, when a Group A dwelling uses wooden posts for support, what is the minimum required cross-sectional area of each wooden post?

options.text: 0.025 square meter (e.g., 100 mm x 250 mm) per post
0.040 square meter (e.g., 200 mm x 200 mm) per post
0.060 square meter (e.g., 200 mm x 300 mm) per post
0.090 square meter (e.g., 300 mm x 300 mm) per post

proposed.rationale: Section 708 requires wooden posts supporting a Group A dwelling to have a minimum cross-sectional area of 0.025 square meter per post. This is commonly achieved with a 100 mm x 250 mm or equivalent section that aggregates to at least 0.025 sq.m.
proposed.explanation: The 0.025 sq.m wooden-post minimum is a Section 708 specific value for Group A dwellings; it sits alongside the 250 mm minimum foundation-wall thickness and the 600 mm minimum depth below natural ground line as the three basic foundation requirements for this occupancy group.
